provenance.title: Floor surfaces by room type
provenance.covers: Usual floor surfaces for each room type, in order of preference, and which are safe in wet rooms. Written from general knowledge in our own words, not copied from the sources.

sources.name: Approved Document C: Resistance to moisture (UK government). Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. Surfaces in order of preference. wetSafe says if the surface is safe where water is used.
